summary: Design privacy controls, rights workflows, and product templates across major privacy regimes. Explore the five-day workshop and course outline.
lede: Cross-jurisdiction data privacy training helps privacy, security, compliance, and product teams coordinate controls across applicable regimes. Participants practise mapping obligations and data flows into a consolidated control model, preparing rights-request workflows, and documenting privacy impact and product review decisions. Exercises also cover vendor reviews, evidence tracking, and prioritizing programme gaps, with automated intake and monitoring considered for evaluation rather than implementation.
audienceIntro: This data privacy programme suits professionals who coordinate privacy obligations, controls, and product decisions across multiple applicable regulatory regimes.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with organizational data handling and at least one privacy, compliance, information security, or digital product process is recommended. No coding or programming is required.
